literal: Noble ones' perfect goodness if decreases, vast earth itself will not bear, alas, burden.
translation: If the perfect goodness of noble people diminishes, the vast earth itself will be unable to bear its burden.
modern: சான்றோர்களின் சிறந்த பண்பு குறைந்துவிட்டால், இந்தப் பெரிய பூமியும் தன் பாரத்தைத் தாங்க முடியாமல் போகும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the foundational importance of noble character to the world. The word 'சான்றவர்' refers to those who are full of excellent qualities, and 'சான்றாண்மை' is their perfect goodness. The poet states that if such people lose their noble nature, the vast earth ('இருநிலம்') will no longer be able to bear its burden ('பொறை'). The particle 'மன்னோ' adds a tone of lament or certainty to this cosmic consequence. It implies that the moral weight of good people is what truly sustains the earth.
